title: Three-body additivity: equilateral A-B-C triangle at side 5, T=4
pitch: Three particles at the vertices of an equilateral triangle of side 5, at rest. Each pair is at r=5, the separation where P-0005 gives pair K values (A-B, A-C, B-C, pairs with two runs each). Pairwise additivity predicts the initial accelerations from those values; the run tests that prediction and the trajectory over T=4 (400 samples). A miss beyond tracker noise falsifies additivity at r=5. Non-pairwise (three-body) terms would show here and nowhere in two-particle runs. Cost is small; the grant allowance is not needed for the test itself.
